scope: Development revision on the same three already evaluated apparatus seeds and four full Unified tasks. Frozen first learned-policy negative results are retained separately. Compare corrected action-cost feedback against the existing same-release policy-disabled control and frozen 0.86; this is not a new unseen confirmation cohort.
persistence: Every task boundary saves and reconstructs the complete Unified session from JSON.
cost_accounting: Source is the first real Unified task and counted once per arm; all later tasks share its paid learned knowledge. Evaluation costs are separate.

preterminal_amendment.reason: Correct policy credit for research induced after the first candidate fit, following the preserved first development comparison.
preterminal_amendment.learning_state_at_addition: Previous three-arm cohort fully evaluated; new revised runtime not released or dispatched.
preterminal_amendment.control_reuse: Same-release disabled control may be reused only if the correction does not change disabled execution.

control_reuse_basis: The correction records ownership and downstream costs only when research policy learning is enabled; the policy-disabled execution path is unchanged.
stop_scope: Prior first-apparatus learning is retained without terminal evaluation; this new development revision includes symmetric program and structural followup cost accounting.
release: Root final release after symmetric program and structural cost attribution checks
